headline: Swarm-inspired peer-to-peer control for resource-aware flexibility sharing in cyber–physical energy systems
name: Swarm-inspired peer-to-peer control for resource-aware flexibility sharing in cyber–physical energy systems
description: Peer-to-peer control of heterogeneous electrically interfaced flexibility resources using dynamic aggregate and target estimation, a graph-local optimization-guided gradient, capacity-normalized sharing, and a local CLF/HOCBF-constrained control step. The published study reports an equal-effort comparator protocol, component ablation, Monte Carlo validation, scalability diagnostics, and explicit simulation and sampled-data scope limitations.
